title: Materialized-copy conflict outcomes
description: The answers an adjudicator may give when a materialized copy changed both locally and upstream since it was fetched. Never a merge rule: which side wins depends on why the local edit was made.

source.note: bean bvuk; owner approved the answer set 2026-09-23

codes.label: Keep the local edit
codes.definition: The local change stays; the upstream change is not applied over it.

codes.label: Take the upstream change
codes.definition: The upstream version replaces the local copy; the local edit is superseded.
